notes: All definitions, clarifications, and examples were drastically shortened across all labels

codes.name: access barriers
codes.definition: Structural obstacles that prevent patients from reaching care.
codes.negative_clarification: NOT cost concerns — price itself is "cost concerns".

positive_examples.text: Nearest clinic is 2 bus transfers away and I can't get there without taking a full day off work.
positive_examples.why: Distance and transport physically block reaching care.

negative_examples.text: I finally saw the doctor but the copay was more than I could afford.
negative_examples.why: Price, not access barrier, is the issue.

codes.name: cost concerns
codes.definition: Worry about the monetary price of care.
codes.negative_clarification: NOT difficulty physically reaching care (that's "access barriers").

positive_examples.text: I skipped the follow-up because I couldn't afford another $200 visit.
positive_examples.why: Care was forgone due to its price.

negative_examples.text: I couldn't get an appointment for three months.
negative_examples.why: This is a scheduling delay, not related to cost.

codes.name: provider trust
codes.definition: Patient's confidence in or distrust of their clinician or the health system.
codes.negative_clarification: NOT general satisfaction with logistics like cost or wait times; this is about provider relationship and credibility.

positive_examples.text: My doctor never listens, so I've started ignoring advice I'm given.
positive_examples.why: Expresses distrust in the provider relationship.

negative_examples.text: Waiting room was crowded and I sat there for an hour.
negative_examples.why: A logistics complaint (wait times), not about trust in provider.

codes.name: wait times
codes.definition: Delay between seeking care and receiving it — appointment lead time or time spent waiting on the day.
codes.negative_clarification: NOT being unable to reach the clinic at all (that's "access barriers"); wait times assume care is reachable but slow.

positive_examples.text: First available appointment was four months out.

negative_examples.text: There's no specialist within a hundred miles of me.
negative_examples.why: Care is unreachable, an access barrier, not merely delayed.
